cap.label: Review cap (verdicts)
cap.description: Verdicts before the loop stops and hands the PR to an adjudicator (cap - 1 fixes)

reviewer_concurrency.label: Reviews at once
reviewer_concurrency.description: Reviews that may run at once; everything above this queues. Above 1 needs a clone path, so each run gets its own sandbox.

fixer_concurrency.label: Fixes at once
fixer_concurrency.description: Fixes that may run at once; everything above this queues

shadow_concurrency.label: Shadow reviews at once
shadow_concurrency.description: Shadow reviews (#218) that may run at once, a whole number >= 1; everything above this queues. Takes effect only while the loop has a shadow profile. Blank = not set here: the loop keeps its own value (default: 1, serialized)

triage_concurrency.label: Issue triages at once
triage_concurrency.description: Issue triages that may run at once, a whole number >= 1; everything above this queues. Takes effect only while the loop has issue triage on. Blank = not set here: the loop keeps its own value (default: 1, serialized)

clone.label: Clone path (required above 1)
clone.description: Local clone the runs isolate from — required above 1, because a parallel run in a shared checkout produces wrong verdicts

grace_min.label: Watchdog grace (minutes)
grace_min.description: Minutes a quiet PR may sit before the watchdog speaks

ttl_min.label: Seat slot TTL (minutes)
ttl_min.description: Minutes a seat slot survives — the backstop for a run that died without a verdict

inflight_ttl_min.label: In-flight mark TTL (minutes)
inflight_ttl_min.description: Minutes an in-flight mark blocks a second run at the same head

turn_budget_s.label: Turn budget (seconds)
turn_budget_s.description: Wall-clock seconds one isolated seat turn may run: Hermes's --run-budget, and the sandbox is killed shortly after. A real review builds and tests, so keep it generous (60-14400)

host.label: Webhook host
host.description: Your gateway's public webhook origin (required to create GitHub hooks)

reviewer_profile.label: Reviewer's Hermes profile
reviewer_profile.description: Profile the reviewer seat runs as. Blank = not set here: a new loop still needs one, and it must differ from the fixer's

fixer_profile.label: Fixer's Hermes profile
fixer_profile.description: Profile the fixer seat runs as. Blank = not set here: a new loop still needs one, and it must differ from the reviewer's

reviewer_login.label: Reviewer's GitHub login
reviewer_login.description: GitHub login the reviewer seat acts as — the login the review route serves. Must be in the loop's reviewers allowlist. Blank = not set here

fixer_login.label: Fixer's GitHub login
fixer_login.description: GitHub login the fixer seat acts as. Must be in the loop's fixers allowlist. Blank = not set here

adjudicator_profile.label: Adjudicator's Hermes profile (optional)
adjudicator_profile.description: Profile that rules when the verdict budget is spent. Blank = not set here: a loop with no adjudicator route is left exactly as it is

reviewer_token_file.label: Reviewer's token file (path only)
reviewer_token_file.description: Absolute path (~ allowed) to the file holding the reviewer login's GitHub PAT — the path only, never the token itself. Must be your own mode-600 regular file. Blank = not set here

fixer_token_file.label: Fixer's token file (path only)
fixer_token_file.description: Absolute path (~ allowed) to the file holding the fixer login's GitHub PAT — the path only, never the token itself. Must be your own mode-600 regular file. Blank = not set here

adjudicator_login.label: Adjudicator's GitHub login (optional)
adjudicator_login.description: Optional fourth account the ruling is also posted as, as a PR comment. Must differ from the reader and both seats, with its own credential (a PAT file, or a GitHub App). Lands only on a loop with an adjudicator route. Blank = not set here

adjudicator_token_file.label: Adjudicator's token file (path only, optional)
adjudicator_token_file.description: Absolute path (~ allowed) to the file holding the adjudicator login's GitHub PAT — the path only, never the token itself. Must be your own mode-600 regular file, not shared with any other login. Blank = not set here

reviewer_app_id.label: Reviewer's GitHub App id
reviewer_app_id.description: Positive ASCII decimal App id, paired with this seat's App key file and bot login. Blank pair = not set here. A complete pair selects App, never PAT.

reviewer_app_key_file.label: Reviewer's App key file (path only)
reviewer_app_key_file.description: Absolute path (~ allowed) to your mode-600 regular private-key file; the path only, never the key itself. Set with the App id. Blank pair = not set here.

fixer_app_id.label: Fixer's GitHub App id
fixer_app_id.description: Positive ASCII decimal App id, paired with this seat's App key file and bot login. Blank pair = not set here. A complete pair selects App, never PAT.

fixer_app_key_file.label: Fixer's App key file (path only)
fixer_app_key_file.description: Absolute path (~ allowed) to your mode-600 regular private-key file; the path only, never the key itself. Set with the App id. Blank pair = not set here.

adjudicator_app_id.label: Adjudicator's GitHub App id
adjudicator_app_id.description: Positive ASCII decimal App id, paired with this seat's App key file and bot login. Blank pair = not set here. A complete pair selects App, never PAT.

adjudicator_app_key_file.label: Adjudicator's App key file (path only)
adjudicator_app_key_file.description: Absolute path (~ allowed) to your mode-600 regular private-key file; the path only, never the key itself. Set with the App id. Blank pair = not set here.

reviewer_max_steps.label: Reviewer's agent steps per turn
reviewer_max_steps.description: Agent steps one reviewer turn may take, 8-200. Blank = not set here: the loop keeps its own value or the role default

fixer_max_steps.label: Fixer's agent steps per turn
fixer_max_steps.description: Agent steps one fixer turn (and an issue fix) may take, 8-200. Blank = not set here: the loop keeps its own value or the role default

reviewer_daily_tokens.label: Reviewer's daily token budget
reviewer_daily_tokens.description: Tokens (in + out) the reviewer may spend per local day, a whole number. Once spent, the next turn waits for midnight; a turn in flight is not killed. Counted by the inference proxy from what the provider reports. Blank = not set here: the loop keeps its own value (default: no budget)

shadow_daily_tokens.label: Shadow reviews' daily token budget
shadow_daily_tokens.description: Tokens (in + out) shadow reviews (#218) may spend per local day, a whole number. Once spent, the next shadow waits for midnight; a review in flight is not killed. Blank = not set here: the loop keeps its own value (default: no budget)

fixer_daily_tokens.label: Fixer's daily token budget
fixer_daily_tokens.description: Tokens (in + out) the fixer, and issue fixes, may spend per local day, a whole number. Once spent, the next turn waits for midnight; a turn in flight is not killed. Blank = not set here: the loop keeps its own value (default: no budget)

auto_fix_labels.label: Auto-fix labels (comma-separated)
auto_fix_labels.description: Triage labels (from triage.labels) that hand an issue to the fixer without a maintainer, e.g. P3, documentation. Needs the loop's triage.fix_label. P0-P2 are never auto-offered. Blank = not set here: the loop keeps its own value (empty by default: person-only trigger)

auto_fix_daily.label: Auto-fix daily cap (issues)
auto_fix_daily.description: Automatic issue fixes per loop per local day, 1-1000 (default 25). Needs the loop's triage.auto_fix_labels. Blank = not set here: the loop keeps its own value or the default

fix_daily_turns.label: Issue-fix daily cap (turns)
fix_daily_turns.description: Issue-fix turns per local day, 1-1000. Needs the loop's triage.fix_label. Blank = not set here: the loop keeps its own value or the default

review_only.label: Review-only authors (comma-separated)
review_only.description: GitHub logins whose PRs the reviewer reviews but the fixer never touches: a changes-requested verdict goes back to the author. Not a fixer or a reviewer. Blank = not set here

review_only_cap.label: Review-only verdict cap
review_only_cap.description: Verdicts the reviewer may give one review-only PR before it stops until a maintainer grants another round, a whole number 1-1000. Blank = not set here: the loop's own value, else the review cap

observer_weekly_report.label: Weekly report (weekday and UTC time)
observer_weekly_report.description: When the observer feed gets the week's report: a weekday and a UTC time like 'mon 09:00'. Needs the loop's observer feed. 'off' turns it off. Blank = not set here: the loop's own value, else none

ci_fix_cap.label: CI-fix turns per PR
ci_fix_cap.description: CI-fix turns per PR (across its heads) before the reviewer reviews a red head, a whole number 1-10. Red required CI goes to the fixer first and spends no review verdict. Blank = not set here: the loop's own value, else 3

review_only_daily.label: Review-only daily cap (turns)
review_only_daily.description: Reviewer turns per local day on review-only PRs, a whole number 1-1000; once spent they wait until midnight. Blank = not set here: the loop's own value, else no cap

review_only_update.label: Merge the base into review-only PRs
review_only_update.description: Off (default): a review-only PR that conflicts gets a notice naming the merged PRs, the files and the commands. On: the host also pushes a clean merge of the base into the author's same-repository branch, with a lease on the head it read (a push to a branch the loop does not own; needs unattended fixer pushes). Never resolves a real conflict or a workflow change. It pushes only a PR GitHub reports as behind, which it does only when the base requires branches to be up to date; without that setting only the notice applies

required_checks.label: Required CI checks (comma-separated)
required_checks.description: The check runs or status contexts that gate an approval, named exactly as GitHub shows them, e.g. 'tests (3.11), lint'. Others are shown to the reviewer as optional and never block. Blank = not set here (an unset list means every check gates)

shadow_profile.label: Shadow review profile
shadow_profile.description: A second reviewer model in no-write mode (#218): the Hermes profile it runs as, never the reviewer's own. Its verdicts are recorded for comparison and never posted. 'off' turns shadow reviews off. Blank = not set here: the loop keeps its own value (default: off)

shadow_every.label: Shadow one in N reviews
shadow_every.description: How often a reviewer turn also gets a shadow review, 1-1000 (1 = every one). Blank = not set here: the loop keeps its own value (default 5)

shadow_escalate.label: Shadow review holds the PR
shadow_escalate.description: on: a PR is not ready to merge while its shadow review is running, or after it requested changes (#1004). Needs shadow every = 1. Blank = not set here: the loop keeps its own value (default: off)

human_paths.label: Human-only paths (comma-separated globs)
human_paths.description: Glob patterns, e.g. '.github/**, scripts/release*'. If a reviewed diff touches one, the loop never approves it: when the reviewer would approve, the approval is left to a person (the head is held, one notice per head); REQUEST_CHANGES still works. '*' also matches '/'. Blank = not set here (an unset list means no path is reserved)

ci_coverage.label: What each CI check covers (NAME=COVERS, ';;' between entries)
ci_coverage.description: Tells the reviewer what a required check ran, e.g. 'tests (3.14)=full unit suite and harness'. A covering check that is green at the head, as the host read it, moves what it covers out of the review's 'Not verified'; a failed, running or missing one does not. Only a check that gates (named in required checks, when that is set) can be cited. Blank = not set here (an unset map means the reviewer is told nothing)

generated.label: Generated files (PATH[,PATH]=COMMAND, ';;' between entries)
generated.description: Generated files the host regenerates when a PR's only merge conflicts are in them, e.g. 'docs/commands.md=python3 tests/commands_doc.py --write'. The command runs only in the sandbox, on the merged tree, no network; its result is pushed only if no conflict marker remains, else a fixer turn resolves it. Takes effect only where a fixer pushes unattended. Blank = not set here (an unset list means the shortcut is off)

fixer_check.label: Fixer's always-run check (command)
fixer_check.description: One command the fixer runs in the checkout before every push or issue-fix PR, besides the tests it touched: the checks CI always runs (chain several with &&). At most 500 characters, one line. Blank = not set here

ingress.label: Where events arrive
ingress.description: repo-hooks or app-webhook. Where the loop's GitHub events arrive: repo-hooks (the default) installs a repo hook per seat; app-webhook takes them from a GitHub App's own webhook (Ingress App below), so the loop needs no repo hooks and no PAT for them. Blank = not set here

ingress_app.label: Ingress App
ingress_app.description: With app-webhook: the bot login (slug[bot]) of the GitHub App whose webhook delivers this loop's events, mapped as an App on the loop. Blank = not set here

merge_check.label: Post the diaktoros/review merge check
merge_check.description: auto, on or off. The check mirrors whether the loop would merge the head (green only when approved and nothing holds it); make it required in branch protection for a block the merge button honours. auto: on when the reviewer is a GitHub App (a check run), off for a PAT reviewer (on: a commit status). Blank = not set here

review_after_ci.label: Review after CI finishes
review_after_ci.description: On: a review waits while the head's checks are still running (up to an hour), then starts with their results. Off: it starts at once, and the reviewer sees whatever CI has finished so far.

fix_ci.label: Fix a failed CI check
fix_ci.description: On: a failed required check on a fixer's PR becomes one fixer turn per head (needs unattended fixer pushes on). Off: a red check is only reported.

fixer_scope_lock.label: Hold fixes outside the findings' files
fixer_scope_lock.description: On: a fix round that changes files the open findings do not name (other than their tests and docs) is held for a maintainer, with a notice listing the extra files; `hermes dk retry` lets it through. Only takes effect with unattended fixer pushes on. Off: no check.

attribution.label: Sign what the loop posts
attribution.description: On: every review, comment and commit the loop itself posts ends with 'Automated by Diaktoros' and a link (commits get an Automated-By trailer). Off: nothing is added. Never touches what people or agents post by hand.
